headline: SEC and France's AMF Sign Supervisory Cooperation Agreement
summary: The US SEC and France's Autorité des Marchés Financiers signed a Memorandum of Understanding to facilitate information sharing and supervision of investment advisers.
why: Cross-border regulatory agreements help securities watchdogs monitor fund managers operating in both European and American financial markets.

impacts.name: Asset Management
impacts.why: Deeper cross-border regulatory coordination increases oversight of multinational investment advisers.
